experiment: Guosheng independent round 2: fixed 2x2 mechanism isolation

supplemental.note: Original economic proxies remain. Diagnostic only.

cells.M00: Monthly first exchange session. Adopt latest known basket, estimate ERC. One next-session refill.
cells.B10: M00 plus immediate extra rebalance only when latest known basket differs from currently held target basket. No daily intra-basket refresh.
cells.W01: Adopt basket only on monthly first exchange session. Reestimate ERC daily on that locked basket even when current macro desired basket has changed.
cells.BW11: Adopt latest known basket and reestimate ERC every exchange session.

fixed.risk: 63 common valid dates, union invalid-date removal, joint dropna; existing risk_parity
fixed.execution: Existing actual/economic engine unchanged, prior-close information, next open/next close, one-session sell-cash delay, lots/ADV/limits unchanged
fixed.fees: 0.00015 commission, min 5 CNY, specified one-way slip; V12 original relative buffer remains

comparison: Rerun V12 for every same start/capital/slip. At 1m 9bp reconcile M00/B10/BW11 against archived monthly/stage_change/daily full ledgers.
outputs: full and Jan+July2026-zeroed metrics at original duration
event_definition: Partition every evaluation date into episodes beginning with first simulation session or next-session known macro basket change, ending before next event. These are accounting attributions, not independent causal estimates.
concentration_control: Zero both candidate and benchmark daily net returns for 2026-01 and 2026-07; retain calendar duration. Months were already seen and are a prespecified diagnostic, not a holdout.
falsifiers: If M00/B10/BW11 archived ledger equality fails, stop interpreting mechanism differences until localized.
If W01 does not add positive net log return versus M00 at 500k for both 9bp and 20bp, reject the claim that daily ERC refresh alone explains the observed frequency advantage.
If any incremental mechanism becomes negative after common Jan/July zeroing, reject a broad-based improvement claim on this already seen year.
No unseen performance or replacement recommendation may be inferred from these runs.
failure_policy: Append every failed run with traceback and preserve outputs; no parameter search or selecting winner.
network: All connections disabled in this process; existing local snapshots only.
